endorsements.quote: Proper documentation of imputation methods and sensitivity analyses would enhance the study’s reproducibility and credibility.
Future prospective, multi-center studies and the incorporation of real-world clinical variables will be critical for improving the model’s robustness, generalizability, and clinical integration.

unlisted_practices: Assess and address collinearity and redundancy among predictors in prediction model development.
Extend prediction model endpoints to multi-year outcomes that align with international surveillance guidelines.
Account for endoscopist-related variability in prediction models of polyp recurrence.
Conduct a decision impact analysis or user-acceptability study to guide clinical implementation of prediction tools.

screen.reason: This is a letter to the editor critiquing a published machine learning prediction model study and offering recommendations for prospective validation and clinical implementation strategy.
